verdict.rationale: Xero documents connecting bank accounts so JAX can automatically categorize and match transactions. It also offers a Stripe payments integration with automated reconciliation, and its App Store lists bank (Mercury) and payroll (Gusto) connectors, so all three system types can feed the ledger. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that payroll activity (e.g., Gusto) posts journals into the ledger automatically, detail on how Stripe payouts and fees sync and reconcile, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor pages and an on-site testimonial.
